name: Gus's Real Exotics | Snow White
description:
*$125 Bogo Flower Tier

Snow White by Gus's Real Exotics is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain crossing White Widow and Northern Lights.

Strain Profile/ Effects:
Type: Indica-dominant hybrid

Aroma: Deeply earthy, sweet, and woody with a sharp kick of pine

Taste: Clean and smooth finish with refreshing citrus undertones on the exhale

Effects: Balanced high providing soothing physical relaxation paired with a calm, clear-headed mental mood lift (without heavy couch-lock)
